description:
Create a complete map layout in QGIS with cartographic elements and export it as a PDF.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Add the polygon layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_polygon.geojson using Layer > Add Layer > Add Vector Layer.
3. Add the point layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/sample_points.geojson.
4. Ensure both layers are visible in the map canvas.
5. Create a new print layout: go to Project > New Print Layout. Enter the layout name 'Sample Data Map' when prompted.
6. Add a map to the layout: click Add Item > Add Map, then draw a rectangle on the layout canvas to place the map. The map should show the loaded layers.
7. Add a title: click Add Item > Add Label. Place it at the top of the layout. Set the text to 'San Francisco Bay Area - GIS Sample Data'.
8. Add a north arrow: click Add Item > Add North Arrow (or Add Item > Add Picture and select a north arrow). Place it in a corner of the layout.
9. Add a scale bar: click Add Item > Add Scale Bar. Place it below the map.
10. Add a legend: click Add Item > Add Legend. Place it beside or below the map.
11. Export the layout as PDF: go to Layout > Export as PDF (or click the Export PDF button). Save to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/sample_map.pdf.

metadata.expected_title: San Francisco Bay Area - GIS Sample Data
